Name: LinkedIn Jobs
Coverage or search terms: Broad product-company and multinational hiring
Collection notes: Sign in to configure saved-search emails (https://www.linkedin.com/help/linkedin/answer/a511279/job-alerts-on-linkedin?lang=en). Process your own alerts via mailbox OAuth. The Job Posting API (https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/talent/job-postings/api/overview) serves publishing partners. A candidate session does not grant bulk search access. User agreement (https://www.linkedin.com/legal/user-agreement)

Name: Indeed
Coverage or search terms: Cross-industry and location-based search
Collection notes: Configure account-based email alerts (https://www.indeed.com/help/job-seekers/articles/204488890-starting-stopping-and-managing-job-alerts). Indeed also documents a publisher search plugin and provisioned partner integrations. Job Sync handles employer postings. Partner docs (https://docs.indeed.com/)

Name: Naukri
Coverage or search terms: Indian product companies and MNCs
Collection notes: Set up alerts by role, experience, and location. Read your own alert emails. Alert setup (https://resume.naukri.com/frequently-asked-questions-faq/how-to-create-free-job-alerts/)

Name: Adzuna
Coverage or search terms: Search across employers in supported countries
Collection notes: Register for an app ID and key. Query the paginated jobs API by country, role, and location.

Name: Himalayas
Coverage or search terms: Remote engineering jobs
Collection notes: Read its public jobs API or RSS feed (https://himalayas.app/docs/remote-jobs-rss). Check country eligibility.

Name: We Work Remotely
Coverage or search terms: Remote jobs by category
Collection notes: Read the public all-jobs or category RSS feed. Verify geographic restrictions per vacancy.

Name: Remotive
Coverage or search terms: Remote engineering
Collection notes: Read its public API. The public feed is delayed by 24 hours and has attribution and reuse conditions.

Name: Hacker News “Who is hiring?”
Coverage or search terms: Monthly hiring-manager posts, including database and AI teams
Collection notes: Find the monthly hiring thread and fetch comments with the public HN API (https://github.com/HackerNews/API). Follow employer links where available.

Coverage or search terms: YC startups, including AI and data infrastructure
Collection notes: Use job search for employer discovery, then save each employer’s careers board. India search (https://www.ycombinator.com/jobs/role/all/india)

Collection notes: Discover companies via job search and resolve listings to their careers pages.
